name: Charged Frostshock Convergence · Fire
primary:
Lightning shoots from your hand into the creature you aim at (or the first one in your line of sight). In instant mode it strikes twice a second while held. Effects:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ lightning + 2.25 ❤ earth + 2 ❤ fire (lightning ×2 on wet, fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 126: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 12 targets in a row, jumps up to 7 blocks, 4.5 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 8 blocks within 0.72 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Heat: sets on fire for 13.5 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
self_description:
